name: ERO Ragnarok Offline 5
source:
Fortress where merchant Chris lives becomes invaded by monsters. A huge reward is promised for monsters extermination, so more and more enthusiastic adventurers try their luck at this horrible place.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
商人克莉丝居住的要塞遭到魔物入侵。讨伐魔物可获得巨额奖金，于是越来越多跃跃欲试的冒险者来到这片可怖之地碰碰运气。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
